defects.title: Reports the shape and columns of its own wrangled frame, which has self-derived flag columns, as the raw dataset's row and column counts. It also does not carry state across steps: 'return the result as a table' dumps the whole dataset instead of the previous top-5 result.
defects.expected_behavior: Step-1 should report the raw dataset shape (13149 rows x 5 columns: date, bike_model, price, quantity_sold, extended_sales). Step-4 should return the step-3 top-5 result as a table.
defects.observed_behavior: On source 9b9ab4ac8fd1, in 3 rounds (152440Z/round-2, 165816Z/round-1, 165816Z/round-2) the agent reported its own wrangled frame, with self-added flag columns, as the dataset: '13149 rows x 7 cols' (negative_value_flag, total_mismatch_flag) at step-1; '13149 rows x 8 cols' (three *_outlier_flag) at step-1; and 10 columns (five *_negative/mismatch/duplicate flags) at step-2 'Identify the columns available'. The raw data has 5 columns. In the 2 rounds where step-4 ran (165816Z round-1/2), 'Return the result as a table' returned the full 13149-row dataset instead of the step-3 top-5 that had just been computed correctly. In 152440Z/round-2, steps 2-4 were blocked by zhipu 429. Reproduction: 3 of 3 valid rounds on this source (9b9ab4ac8fd1). Step-4 state loss: 2 of 2 rounds where it ran. Flag columns reported as dataset shape or columns: 3 of 3 (step-1 twice, step-2 once)..
